# Noah and the Rainbow (Genesis 9:13)

## Emotional Focus
Thankfulness after a hard storm or rainy day.

## Key KJV
“I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.” (Genesis 9:13)

## Gentle Retelling
After the big flood, God put a rainbow in the sky as a promise. Every time Noah saw it, he remembered God’s care and said thank You. The rainbow still reminds us God keeps His promises.

## Coloring Prompt
Bright rainbow arching over Noah’s ark on a calm, sunny day after rain; gentle animals peeking out.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“After hard days, look for God’s promises. Thank Him for keeping you safe.”
